name: Baingan Tofu Bharta
ingredients: Garlic, green chilli, coriander and 1 tsp oil
steps: Roast eggplant until soft; peel and mash.
Cook onion, tomato and garlic in oil.
note: Roasting keeps added oil low; tofu replaces richer additions.

inspirationReferences.title: Baingan Bharta Recipe (Smoky Mashed Eggplant)
inspirationReferences.note: Open-flame roasting and smoky eggplant-mash technique; tofu addition and measured oil are our adaptation.
